preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s.strip()) <= 3e5 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s is non-empty and its total length across all test cases does not exceed 3e5.
Each test case string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The first line of stdin is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i*2] == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()[i*2+1]) == len(s)+1 and not is_palindrome(stdout.splitlines()[i*2+1])) or (stdout.splitlines()[i*2] == 'NO' and not any(not is_palindrome(s[:i]+'a'+s[i:]) for i in range(len(s)+1))) for i, s in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, if there exists an index i (0 ≤ i ≤ len(s)) such that inserting 'a' at i produces a non-palindrome, then output 'YES' followed by one such valid string. Otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i*2] == 'YES') == any(not is_palindrome(s[:i]+'a'+s[i:]) for i in range(len(s)+1)) for i, s in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output 'YES' is present if and only if at least one valid insertion of 'a' exists that produces a non-palindrome.
